title: Light Theme + Dark Contrast Fix — Review Map
description: Review map for the theme system change. A light theme is now supported alongside dark, switchable from the toolbar. Dark-mode contrast was also improved. Click each node to jump to the exact code.

meta.reviewTarget: theme system — CSS variables + data-theme + Monaco dual themes + dark contrast fix

layers.name: Theme Mechanism
layers.description: CSS variables driven by a data-theme attribute; the whole palette flips by changing one attribute.

modules.name: tailwind.config.js — tokens → CSS vars
modules.description: All color tokens now resolve to var(--wc-*) instead of hardcoded hex. Class names unchanged.

modules.name: styles.css — two variable sets
modules.description: Defines --wc-* variables under [data-theme='dark'] and [data-theme='light']. Dark text/border values were lifted for contrast.

elements.name: dark variables + contrast lift
elements.description: ink-200 #ccc→#d4d4d4, ink-300 #999→#b8b8b8, ink-400 #6e6e6e→#909090, borders lifted too.

elements.name: light variables
elements.description: Light surfaces (#f8f8f8/#fff), dark text (#333), softer shadows, lighter accent.

modules.name: theme.tsx — ThemeProvider + useTheme
modules.description: React context holding the current theme + toggleTheme. Persists to localStorage; applies data-theme to <html>.

elements.name: readInitialTheme()
elements.description: Reads localStorage 'wc:theme' before React mounts; default dark.

elements.name: toggleTheme()
elements.description: Flips dark↔light, triggers the useEffect that sets the attribute + persists.

modules.name: index.html — anti-flash inline script
modules.description: Sets data-theme from localStorage before React mounts, avoiding a flash of wrong theme. CSP hash added to allow it.

layers.name: Renderer Adaptation
layers.description: Components that can't read CSS vars purely via Tailwind classes — Monaco, React Flow, edge labels.

modules.name: CodeView.tsx — Monaco dual themes
modules.description: Defines walkingcode-dark + walkingcode-light; switches via setTheme on mount and when the theme changes.

elements.name: walkingcode-light theme
elements.description: White background, light syntax tokens (VS-style), light selection/guides.

elements.name: theme switch effect
elements.description: useEffect([theme]) calls monaco.editor.setTheme when the app theme changes at runtime.

modules.name: DiagramView.tsx — RF colors from CSS vars
modules.description: Background dots, minimap node colors, mask, and stroke read from CSS vars via getComputedStyle. useTheme forces re-render on switch.

modules.name: layout.ts — edge label colors
modules.description: Edge label fill + background now read --wc-edge-label / --wc-edge-label-bg via a cssVar() helper.

modules.name: Node components — shadow + hover
modules.description: ModuleNode/ParticipantNode shadow uses --wc-shadow; MessageNode hover uses surface-overlay instead of white overlay.

layers.name: Toggle Entry Point
layers.description: The UI control and the app-level wiring.

modules.name: Toolbar.tsx — sun/moon toggle
modules.description: Icon button in the toolbar; calls toggleTheme(). Shows sun in dark mode, moon in light.

modules.name: main.tsx — ThemeProvider wrapper
modules.description: Wraps <App> in <ThemeProvider> so useTheme is available everywhere.

edges.label: tokens reference
edges.description: tailwind tokens resolve to the CSS vars defined in styles.css.

edges.label: sets data-theme
edges.description: ThemeProvider flips the attribute that switches the variable set.

edges.label: toggleTheme()
edges.description: The toolbar button calls the context's toggle.

edges.label: useTheme
edges.description: CodeView reads the theme to pick the Monaco theme name.

edges.label: useTheme re-render
edges.description: DiagramView uses the theme to trigger re-reading CSS vars.

edges.label: cssVar()
edges.description: layout.ts reads the active var at render time.

edges.label: sets attribute early
edges.description: The inline script applies the theme before React, preventing a flash.
